claims.text: UNL’s Lagos edition prescribes cession with limited Docemo adjudication; Hansard transmits his bombardment-threat protest. Johnson’s web transcription prescribes officers and constabulary at Ibadan under named local authorities. Ibadan University corroborates the Bále office, not Fijabi’s precise powers. These are distinct mediated relations, not identical accession or universal consent.

claims.text: What prevents one generic colonial label from explaining both local relations? Lagos cession retains bounded Docemo adjudication, while the Ibadan agreement names Bále/authorities and prescribes officers/constabulary. The locally corroborated office and attributed coercion cannot become conquest or popular assent.
